title: ExtravaganZZa
description: Domino’s most loaded pizza: four meats, four vegetables and extra cheese on one base.
fullContent:
The ExtravaganZZa is the pizza Domino’s piles highest: pepperoni, ham, Italian sausage and beef, then onions, green peppers, mushrooms and black olives, finished with extra cheese. It is the specialty pizza that carries the most toppings, which is exactly why it is the best value one on the menu if you like what is on it.

Where it fits on value

Every specialty pizza in our check cost the same for a large — $19.99 — whether it carried four toppings or nine. The ExtravaganZZa carries nine, so it gives you the most food for the same money. Building the same nine toppings yourself on a cheese pizza would cost far more; the comparison table on this page shows by how much.

It is also the pizza that gets the most out of a flat-price deal, because a deal that prices any large pizza the same charges nothing extra for the toppings.

Ordering notes

Nine toppings on a hand-tossed base is a heavy, wet pizza. Ask for a well-done bake if you want the centre to hold, and avoid thin crust for this one — it cannot carry the load. It travels reasonably well because the cheese layer holds everything in place, but it is at its best collected.

Ingredients are as Domino’s describes this pizza; recipes change and vary by region, so check the current description in the app before ordering around an allergy.
caloriesNote: Per slice of a large hand-tossed pizza cut into eight, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Fully loaded pizza with pepperoni, sausage, peppers, onions and olives

faqs.question: How much is a large ExtravaganZZa?
faqs.answer: $19.99 for a large (14-inch) hand-tossed ExtravaganZZa at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026, before tax. Other sizes are estimates. Prices vary by store.

faqs.question: What is on the ExtravaganZZa?
faqs.answer: Pepperoni, ham, Italian sausage and beef, plus onions, green peppers, mushrooms and black olives, with extra cheese. It is the most heavily topped specialty pizza on the menu.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper than building the same pizza yourself?
faqs.answer: Yes, by a wide margin. All the large specialty pizzas we checked cost $19.99, and the ExtravaganZZa carries more toppings than any of them — adding nine toppings one by one to a cheese pizza costs considerably more.

title: MeatZZa
description: Four meats and extra cheese, no vegetables — the specialty pizza for meat eaters.
fullContent:
The MeatZZa takes the meat half of the ExtravaganZZa — pepperoni, ham, Italian sausage and beef — adds extra cheese and leaves the vegetables off. It is the specialty pizza for tables where nobody wants peppers or olives, and it is a heavier, saltier pizza than the topping count suggests.

Where it fits on value

At $19.99 for a large in our check it costs exactly the same as every other specialty pizza, including the ExtravaganZZa, which has the same four meats plus four vegetables. If you would happily eat the vegetables, the ExtravaganZZa is more food for the same price; if you would pick them off, the MeatZZa is the right order.

Ordering notes

Four cured meats release a lot of fat as they cook. A well-done bake crisps the edges and reduces the pooling in the centre. If you are feeding a mixed group, pairing one MeatZZa with one vegetable pizza covers more people than two of either.

Ingredients are as Domino’s describes this pizza; recipes change and vary by region, so check the current description in the app before ordering around an allergy.
caloriesNote: Per slice of a large hand-tossed pizza cut into eight, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Meat pizza loaded with pepperoni and sausage on a dark serving tray

faqs.question: How much is a large MeatZZa?
faqs.answer: $19.99 for a large hand-tossed MeatZZa at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026. Other sizes are estimates, and prices vary by store.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the MeatZZa and the ExtravaganZZa?
faqs.answer: The vegetables. Both carry pepperoni, ham, Italian sausage, beef and extra cheese; the ExtravaganZZa adds onions, green peppers, mushrooms and black olives for the same price.

faqs.question: How many calories are in a slice?
faqs.answer: About 360 per slice of a large hand-tossed MeatZZa, as listed in the official cart — one of the heavier pizzas on the menu.

title: Pacific Veggie
description: A vegetable pizza with spinach, roasted red peppers, feta and garlic herb seasoning.
fullContent:
The Pacific Veggie is Domino’s main vegetarian specialty pizza: roasted red peppers, spinach, onions, mushrooms, tomatoes and black olives, with feta and provolone over the mozzarella and a garlic herb seasoning on top. It is one of the lighter specialty pizzas per slice and one of the most heavily topped.

Where it fits on value

It costs the same as every other large specialty pizza in our check — $19.99 — and carries more toppings than most of them. For a vegetarian at the table it is far better value than building a vegetable pizza topping by topping.

Ordering notes

Six vegetables hold a lot of water. On a long delivery the centre softens; a well-done bake helps, and collecting it helps more. If someone at the table is vegan rather than vegetarian, this pizza is not suitable as ordered — it carries three cheeses — and our vegetarian and vegan guide covers what to change.

Ingredients are as Domino’s describes this pizza; recipes change and vary by region, so check the current description in the app before ordering around an allergy.
caloriesNote: Per slice of a large hand-tossed pizza cut into eight, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Vegetable pizza topped with peppers, mushrooms and onions on a wooden board

faqs.question: How much is a large Pacific Veggie?
faqs.answer: $19.99 for a large hand-tossed Pacific Veggie at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026. Other sizes are estimates.

faqs.question: Is the Pacific Veggie vegetarian?
faqs.answer: It has no meat, but it is topped with mozzarella, provolone and feta, so it is vegetarian rather than vegan. Check the official allergen information if you avoid particular ingredients.

faqs.question: Is it lighter than the meat pizzas?
faqs.answer: Yes. About 310 calories per slice of a large in the official cart, against 360–370 for the MeatZZa and ExtravaganZZa.

title: Memphis BBQ Chicken
description: Barbecue sauce instead of tomato, with grilled chicken, onions, provolone and cheddar.
fullContent:
The Memphis BBQ Chicken swaps the tomato sauce for barbecue sauce and tops it with grilled chicken and onions under provolone and cheddar. The sauce changes the pizza more than any topping does: it is sweeter, smokier and much less acidic than the rest of the menu.

Where it fits on value

This is the one specialty pizza where building it yourself can come close to the specialty price. It carries fewer toppings than most, and if your store lets you choose BBQ sauce as the base of a build-your-own, chicken and onions on a cheese pizza may cost about the same as the $19.99 specialty. Check both totals before you order.

Ordering notes

Barbecue sauce caramelises and can catch at the edges on a well-done bake, so the normal bake is usually the better choice here. It is a good second pizza for a group because it tastes nothing like the pepperoni or cheese pizza next to it.

Ingredients are as Domino’s describes this pizza; recipes change and vary by region, so check the current description in the app before ordering around an allergy.
caloriesNote: Per slice of a large hand-tossed pizza cut into eight, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: BBQ chicken pizza with red onion and herbs, one slice lifted

faqs.question: How much is a large Memphis BBQ Chicken pizza?
faqs.answer: $19.99 for a large hand-tossed Memphis BBQ Chicken at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026. Other sizes are estimates.

faqs.question: Does it have tomato sauce?
faqs.answer: No — barbecue sauce replaces the tomato sauce as the base, which is why it tastes so different from the rest of the menu.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to build it yourself?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. It has fewer toppings than most specialty pizzas, so chicken and onions on a cheese pizza with BBQ sauce as the base can cost close to the specialty price. Price both before ordering.

title: Philly Cheese Steak Pizza
description: The cheesesteak sandwich on a pizza: steak, onions, peppers and mushrooms under provolone.
fullContent:
The Philly Cheese Steak pizza builds the sandwich on a pizza base: thin-sliced steak, onions, green peppers and mushrooms under provolone and American cheese. Domino’s also sells a Philly Cheese Steak sandwich — $8.99 in our check — so you can compare the two forms of the same idea directly.

Where it fits on value

A large costs $19.99 in our check, the same as every other specialty pizza. It feeds two to three people; two Philly sandwiches at $8.99 each come to $17.98 and feed two. If everyone wants cheesesteak, the pizza is the better buy for three people and the sandwiches for two.

Ordering notes

Steak dries out faster than cured meats, so this is a pizza to eat promptly rather than one to keep for later. It is lighter per slice than the four-meat pizzas despite being a meat pizza.

Ingredients are as Domino’s describes this pizza; recipes change and vary by region, so check the current description in the app before ordering around an allergy.
caloriesNote: Per slice of a large hand-tossed pizza cut into eight, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Philly cheese steak pizza with sliced steak, green peppers, mushrooms and melted cheese on a wooden board

faqs.question: How much is a large Philly Cheese Steak pizza?
faqs.answer: $19.99 for a large hand-tossed Philly Cheese Steak pizza at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026. Other sizes are estimates.

faqs.question: Is the pizza or the sandwich better value?
faqs.answer: For three people, the pizza: one large at $19.99 feeds two to three, while each Philly sandwich is $8.99. For two people, two sandwiches at $17.98 are slightly cheaper.

faqs.question: How many calories are in a slice?
faqs.answer: About 310 per slice of a large, as listed in the official cart — lighter than the MeatZZa or ExtravaganZZa.

title: Pepperoni Pizza
description: The most-ordered pizza in the country, and the item most deals are built around. One topping, endlessly reliable.
fullContent:
Pepperoni outsells every other topping in America by a wide margin, and chain menus are built around that fact. When a deal says "one-topping pizza", it is expecting you to pick pepperoni. When a bundle sets a flat price, pepperoni is the item that price was modelled on. Knowing that helps: the single-topping pepperoni pizza is the most heavily discounted item on most menus precisely because it is the most predictable.

What you are actually getting

Sauce, mozzarella and a full covering of sliced pepperoni. The quantity varies more between stores than people realise — a light-handed store and a generous one produce visibly different pizzas from the same recipe. If yours consistently runs light, asking for extra pepperoni is a paid modification but a small one relative to the pizza price.

Where it fits on value

This is the item to put in a deal slot. At full menu price a large pepperoni sits a topping charge above a cheese pizza ($13.99 for a large cheese in our check); inside a carryout offer or a mix-and-match bundle, that topping premium usually vanishes entirely, which makes it the highest-value single choice on the board.

Ordering notes

Pepperoni releases oil as it cooks, so a well-done bake produces crisper edges and a slightly less greasy surface. If you dislike the pooling, ask for well done and place the order for collection rather than delivery — the extra time in a box is what turns that oil into a soggy centre.
caloriesNote: Estimated, per slice of a large hand-tossed pizza cut into eight.
imageAlt: Photo of a baked pepperoni pizza with melted mozzarella

faqs.question: Why does the amount of pepperoni vary between stores?
faqs.answer: Portioning is done by hand against a target count. Two stores following the same spec can still land in different places depending on who is on the make line, which is why the same order can look different in two towns.

faqs.question: Is pepperoni a free topping in deals?
faqs.answer: In one-topping and two-topping deals, yes — it counts as one of your included toppings with no surcharge. Extra pepperoni beyond that is a paid modification.

faqs.question: How do I stop the pizza being greasy?
faqs.answer: Order it well done, and collect it rather than having it delivered if you can. Most of the greasiness people complain about is oil that has had twenty minutes to soak into the base inside a closed box.

faqs.question: Does it reheat well?
faqs.answer: Better than most. A few minutes in a hot dry pan on the hob restores the base far better than a microwave, which turns the crust to leather and the cheese to liquid.

title: Cheese Pizza
description: The baseline against which every other pizza on the menu is priced. Sauce, mozzarella, crust — nothing to hide behind.
fullContent:
A plain cheese pizza is the most useful thing on any chain menu, and not because it is the best-tasting. It is the reference price. Every topping charge, every specialty pizza premium and every deal saving is measured against what a cheese pizza costs at your store, so knowing that number turns the rest of the menu from guesswork into arithmetic.

What you are actually getting

A layer of tomato sauce, a full covering of shredded mozzarella, and whichever crust you pick. Because there is nothing else on it, crust choice matters more here than on any other pizza: a hand-tossed cheese pizza and a thin-crust cheese pizza are noticeably different products, not the same pizza on a different base.

Where it fits on value

On its own, at full menu price, a large cheese pizza is rarely the best value on the board — the carryout and bundle offers almost always beat it. Where it earns its place is inside a deal. If a bundle lets you pick any two items at a flat rate, a cheese pizza is one of the cheapest things you can put in that slot, which is fine if you are feeding someone who does not want toppings anyway.

Ordering notes

Hand tossed is not offered in extra large — the 16-inch size uses the New York Style crust, so an extra-large cheese pizza is a different, thinner pizza.

Ask for a light bake if you like a softer centre and an extra minute or two if you want the cheese properly browned; both are free and both are honoured more often than people expect. Extra cheese is a paid modification and, at most stores, adds a meaningful amount to the price of an otherwise cheap pizza — check the total before you commit.
caloriesNote: Per slice of a large hand-tossed pizza cut into eight, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Classic cheese pizza cut into eight slices on a white plate

faqs.question: Is a cheese pizza cheaper than building my own with no toppings?
faqs.answer: They are usually the same product at the same price — a build-your-own with zero toppings is a cheese pizza. If your store shows a different price for each, order whichever line item is cheaper; the pizza that arrives will be identical.

faqs.question: How many people does a large cheese pizza feed?
faqs.answer: Two to three adults as a meal, or four if there are sides on the table. A large cut into eight slices gives each of three people two to three slices, which is where most people stop.

faqs.question: Does extra cheese cost much?
faqs.answer: It is a paid modification and typically adds a couple of dollars, which is a large percentage increase on an item this cheap. If you want more cheese for less money, a bundle that includes a specialty pizza is often better value than upgrading a plain one.

faqs.question: Can I get a cheese pizza on any crust?
faqs.answer: Yes, on every crust the store offers, though thicker crusts sometimes carry a small upcharge on larger sizes. The crust choice changes the pizza more than any other single decision when there are no toppings involved.

title: Hand-Tossed Build Your Own
description: The default crust and the most flexible item on the menu. Start from cheese, add what you want, watch the price move.
fullContent:
Hand tossed is the crust most people mean when they say pizza: a medium-thickness base with a raised outer edge, soft in the centre, chewy at the rim. It is the default on almost every chain menu and the crust every deal assumes unless it says otherwise.

How the pricing works

You start at the cheese pizza price and each topping adds a fixed amount. Our per-topping figure is an estimate — we have checked the large base price, not the topping charge — and premium toppings such as chicken or steak can cost more. This is where build-your-own gets expensive: by the fourth topping on a large you are paying more than a specialty pizza that already carries those toppings. The tables on this page show exactly where that line falls.

Where it fits on value

Excellent inside a deal, poor outside one. A two-topping build-your-own is the standard qualifying item for mix-and-match bundles and flat-price carryout offers, and at that fixed price it is the best value on the menu. At full menu price with four toppings, it is the worst.

Ordering notes

Count your toppings before you check out. The single most common way people overspend on chain pizza is adding a fourth and fifth topping to a build-your-own without noticing that a specialty pizza with those same toppings would have cost less. The reverse is also true: if a specialty pizza has only two toppings you actually want, building it yourself is usually cheaper.

Hand tossed stops at large. The extra-large 16-inch pizza is only offered on the New York Style crust.

Free modifications worth knowing: light or extra sauce, light cheese, well-done bake, and cutting into squares rather than wedges. None of these cost anything and all of them change the pizza.
caloriesNote: For a plain base, per slice of a large cut into eight, as listed in the official cart. Each topping adds roughly 10–40 calories per slice.
imageAlt: Hand-tossed cheese pizza with a puffy golden crust, one slice pulled away

faqs.question: At how many toppings does a specialty pizza become cheaper?
faqs.answer: Usually at three or four on a large, depending on your store's per-topping rate. Once you are past three toppings it is always worth checking the specialty section before you check out.

faqs.question: Which modifications are free?
faqs.answer: Light or extra sauce, light cheese, a well-done or light bake, and square-cut instead of wedge-cut are free at most stores. Extra cheese and extra meat are paid.

faqs.question: Is hand tossed the crust used in deals?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is the default. Other crusts may carry an upcharge inside a deal or be excluded entirely, which the offer terms will state.

faqs.question: Is there an extra-large hand tossed pizza?
faqs.answer: No. Hand tossed is offered in small, medium and large; the 16-inch extra large uses the New York Style crust.

title: Crunchy Thin Crust Build Your Own
description: A cracker-thin base, cut into squares at most stores. Fewer calories per slice and a completely different eating experience.
fullContent:
Thin crust is not a smaller version of hand tossed — it is a different product. The base is rolled rather than tossed, there is no raised rim, and it comes out of the oven crisp rather than chewy. Most stores cut it into squares, which changes how a group eats it.

How the pricing works

Priced the same as hand tossed at most chains, with the same per-topping charges. Crust is usually a free choice, which makes this the cheapest way to cut calories on a chain pizza: you keep the toppings and the price and lose a meaningful amount of dough.

Where it fits on value

Identical on price, better on calories, worse on volume. A large thin crust does not feed as many people as a large hand tossed, because there is simply less food on the same diameter. If you are ordering for a group, size up or add a side.

Ordering notes

Thin crust does not cope with heavy toppings. Load it with five wet items and the middle will not hold. Two or three toppings is the practical ceiling, and vegetables in particular should be ordered with a well-done bake.

It also goes stale faster than a thicker base. Thin crust is the worst pizza on the menu for leftovers and the best for eating immediately, so order it when you plan to finish it.
caloriesNote: Estimated, for a plain base, per slice of a large cut into eight equivalent portions.
imageAlt: Thin-crust cheese pizza cut into squares on a wooden board

faqs.question: Does thin crust cost less than hand tossed?
faqs.answer: Usually the same price. Crust choice is normally free, which is why thin crust is the cheapest available way to reduce the calorie count of a pizza without changing the toppings.

faqs.question: How many calories does it actually save?
faqs.answer: Roughly a third off the base, depending on size — the toppings and cheese are unchanged. Over a whole large pizza that is a substantial difference for a decision that costs nothing.

faqs.question: Why is it cut into squares?
faqs.answer: A crisp base without a raised rim holds its shape better in squares than in wedges, and square-cut portions are easier to share. Most stores will cut it into wedges instead if you ask.

faqs.question: Can I load it with toppings?
faqs.answer: Not heavily. Two or three is the practical limit before the centre struggles to support the weight. If you want five toppings, order them on hand tossed or pan.

title: Handmade Pan Build Your Own
description: Thick, buttery and baked in a pan for a fried bottom edge. The heaviest crust and often the one that carries an upcharge.
fullContent:
Pan pizza is baked in an oiled pan rather than directly on the oven surface, which fries the underside as it bakes and produces the crisp, golden bottom edge that people either love or find far too rich. It is the thickest crust on most menus.

How the pricing works

Unlike thin crust, pan frequently carries an upcharge — a dollar or two above the hand-tossed price, and it comes in one size, a 12-inch medium, because the pans are a fixed size. Both facts are easy to miss and both affect whether a deal applies to it.

Where it fits on value

Poor value inside a deal, because the upcharge is applied on top of the deal price at most stores and eats into the saving. Reasonable value at full menu price if pan is specifically what you want, since the extra dough genuinely is more food.

Ordering notes

It is the best crust on the menu for leftovers. The oil in the base protects it overnight in a way that thin crust cannot manage, and a reheated pan slice in a hot oven is genuinely good rather than merely acceptable.

It is also the highest-calorie crust by a clear margin. If you are watching that, the same toppings on hand tossed cost you nothing extra and save a noticeable amount per slice.
caloriesNote: Estimated, for a plain base, per slice of a medium cut into eight.
imageAlt: Thick pan pizza in a black pan showing its tall, airy crust

faqs.question: Why does pan crust cost more?
faqs.answer: There is more dough, it uses a dedicated pan, and it occupies oven space differently. Most stores apply a small upcharge that also applies on top of deal pricing, which is worth checking before you assume an offer covers it.

faqs.question: Why is there no extra-large pan pizza?
faqs.answer: The pans are a fixed size. Handmade Pan is made as a 12-inch medium only, so a group needs more pans rather than a bigger one.

faqs.question: Is pan the best crust for leftovers?
faqs.answer: Yes, by some distance. The oil in the base keeps it from drying out overnight, and it reheats well in a hot oven. Thin crust is the worst for the same reason.

faqs.question: How much heavier is it than hand tossed?
faqs.answer: Meaningfully — usually in the region of eighty extra calories per slice on a large, before toppings. If that matters, hand tossed with identical toppings is a free swap.

title: Garlic & Parmesan Bread Bites
description: Sixteen bite-size pieces of pizza dough, baked with garlic or with parmesan. The cheapest side on the menu.
fullContent:
Bread Bites are pizza dough cut into small pieces, baked and finished with garlic or parmesan — sixteen to an order. They are the cheapest side on the menu at $5.99 in our check, and the easiest way to make an order feel bigger for very little.

Where it fits on value

Sixteen pieces for $5.99 is about 37 cents a piece. As a side for four people that is four pieces each for $1.50 a head. Inside a two-for bundle they are one of the strongest picks if the deal charges the same flat rate for any qualifying item, because the bread costs the store very little and the bundle price does not care.

Ordering notes

No dip comes with Bread Bites by default. Dipping cups are extra — $0.99 each in our check, with marinara, garlic, ranch and others to choose from — so add one deliberately if you want it.

Like all bread sides they harden as they cool, so they are a side to eat with the pizza rather than to keep for later. An oven brings them back; a microwave does not.
caloriesNote: Per 4 pieces, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Garlic bread pieces with a pot of marinara dipping sauce

faqs.question: How much are Domino’s Bread Bites?
faqs.answer: $5.99 for 16 pieces, garlic or parmesan, at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026, before tax.

faqs.question: Is a dip included?
faqs.answer: Not by default. Dipping cups cost $0.99 each in our check, so add one if you want it.

faqs.question: How many people do 16 Bread Bites feed?
faqs.answer: About four as a side alongside pizza, at four pieces each.

title: Stuffed Cheesy Bread
description: Bread stuffed with melted cheese and served with marinara, in four flavours. Worth the upgrade over plain bread more often than not.
fullContent:
Cheesy bread is what happens when the kitchen puts pizza cheese on the breadstick dough. It is pulled apart rather than dipped, and it is one of the few sides on a chain menu that people order for its own sake rather than as a filler.

Where it fits on value

$8.49 in our check against $5.99 for Bread Bites — $2.50 more, which is a large percentage increase but a small absolute one, and the Stuffed Cheesy Bread includes a marinara cup that Bread Bites do not. Inside a flat-rate bundle it costs the same as plain breadsticks, which makes it the obvious pick — if the deal charges one price for either, always take the cheese.

Ordering notes

It is the side most damaged by a long delivery. Melted cheese on bread sets as it cools and the texture changes completely; twenty minutes in a box is enough to notice. On a carryout order it is excellent, on a forty-minute delivery it is merely fine.

All four flavours cost the same, so the choice is free. The Bacon & Jalapeño came with a ranch cup as well as marinara in our check.

Calorie note

Per piece this is one of the heavier items on the menu, comparable to a slice of pizza. It is easy to treat as a light side and it is not one.
caloriesNote: Per piece (classic), as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Photo of stuffed cheesy bread pulled apart showing melted cheese

faqs.question: How much is Stuffed Cheesy Bread?
faqs.answer: $8.49 for any of the four flavours — classic, pepperoni, bacon & jalapeño, spinach & feta — at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026.

faqs.question: Does it survive delivery?
faqs.answer: Less well than most sides. Melted cheese firms up as it cools and the texture changes noticeably within about twenty minutes. It is at its best on a carryout order.

faqs.question: How does it compare to a slice of pizza on calories?
faqs.answer: Closely. Per piece it is in the same territory as a slice of hand-tossed pizza, which surprises people who order it as a light extra alongside a full pizza.

title: 8-Piece Wings
description: Oven-baked bone-in wings in four flavours: plain, hot buffalo, honey BBQ and sweet mango habanero.
fullContent:
Wings are the item where expectations most often diverge from reality. At most pizza chains they are baked in the same conveyor oven as the pizza rather than deep fried, which produces a different result to a dedicated wing shop — less crisp, less greasy, and cooked to a consistent standard.

Where it fits on value

$10.99 for eight in our check — about $1.37 a wing — and poor on food per dollar, because a substantial share of the weight is bone. The Loaded Chicken at $8.99 for eight boneless pieces is cheaper and all meat. They are rarely the best value item in a bundle and are frequently excluded from the cheapest offers or surcharged inside them.

Ordering notes

Every flavour costs the same, so choose freely. Dipping cups such as blue cheese or ranch are extra — $0.99 each in our check.

If you want them crisper, ask for well done. Because they are oven-baked, extra time in the oven genuinely improves the skin rather than drying them out the way it would with fried wings.

Realistic portioning

Eight wings is a side for two people, not a meal for one. If wings are the main event of your order rather than an accompaniment, count on ten to twelve per person and price accordingly — at which point a second pizza is usually the cheaper way to feed the same table.
caloriesNote: Per 4 pieces (plain), as listed in the official cart; sauced flavours run 260–310.
imageAlt: Plate of roasted chicken wings with a ranch dip

faqs.question: How much are 8 wings at Domino’s?
faqs.answer: $10.99 for eight, in any of four flavours, at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026. Dipping cups are $0.99 extra.

faqs.question: Are chain pizza wings fried?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Most pizza chains bake them in the same conveyor oven as the pizzas, which gives a consistent result but a softer skin than a deep-fried wing from a dedicated wing shop.

faqs.question: How many wings per person?
faqs.answer: As a side alongside pizza, four to five. As the main item, ten to twelve. At that point a second pizza usually feeds the same people for less money.

faqs.question: Can I get them crispier?
faqs.answer: Ask for well done. Because they are oven-baked rather than fried, additional oven time improves the skin instead of drying the meat out.

title: Loaded Chicken
description: Boneless chicken topped and baked in four styles, from classic hot buffalo to spicy jalapeño-pineapple.
fullContent:
Loaded Chicken is boneless chicken baked with a sauce and toppings rather than served plain — four styles in our check, from Classic Hot Buffalo to Spicy Jalapeño-Pineapple, all at the same price. It sits between wings and a pizza: a protein side that arrives already dressed.

Where it fits on value

$8.99 for eight pieces in our check, against $10.99 for eight bone-in wings. Because there is no bone, almost everything you pay for is edible, so on food per dollar it beats the wings comfortably. All four styles cost the same, so the choice is free.

Ordering notes

Toppings baked onto the chicken travel better than sauce tossed over fried breading, so this is one of the more delivery-proof items on the menu. For a group, two different styles go down better than two of the same, for the same money.

Plan on about four pieces each as a side, or eight as a light main for one person.
caloriesNote: Classic Hot Buffalo, as listed in the official cart (the cart gives the basis as 8 pieces); other styles 200–270.
imageAlt: Boneless chicken pieces with dipping sauce

faqs.question: How much is Loaded Chicken?
faqs.answer: $8.99 for eight pieces in any of the four styles at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026.

faqs.question: Is it better value than wings?
faqs.answer: On food per dollar, yes: $8.99 for eight boneless pieces against $10.99 for eight bone-in wings, and none of it is bone.

faqs.question: Which style is lightest?
faqs.answer: Classic Hot Buffalo and Spicy Jalapeño-Pineapple were listed at 200 calories in the cart, Sweet BBQ Bacon at 230 and Crispy Bacon & Tomato at 270, on the basis the cart gives.

title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta & Mac
description: Oven-baked pasta in a dish: chicken alfredo, 5-cheese mac & cheese, or a spicy buffalo mac — all one price.
fullContent:
Baked pasta is a strange thing to find on a pizza menu and it exists for a specific reason: it is a qualifying item in mix-and-match bundles, and it gives a table someone who does not want pizza an option that does not blow up the order total.

Where it fits on value

This is its whole case. At $8.49 in our check — the same for the chicken alfredo and both mac & cheese dishes — a single baked pasta is unremarkable value on its own. At a flat bundle rate alongside a pizza, it is one of the better ways to add variety to an order without adding cost.

What you are actually getting

Penne, a cream-based alfredo sauce, diced grilled chicken and a cheese topping, baked in a foil dish until the top browns. Portion size is one adult serving and it is genuinely one serving, not the generous restaurant kind.

Ordering notes

Cream sauces separate when they sit. This item is at its best within about fifteen minutes of leaving the oven and declines noticeably after that, which makes it a better carryout choice than a long-delivery one.

It is also one of the heaviest items per portion on the menu: 590 calories for the chicken alfredo and 830–840 for the mac & cheese dishes in the official cart — more than two slices of a large pizza. People order it as the lighter option and it usually is not.
caloriesNote: Per dish (chicken alfredo), as listed in the official cart; the mac & cheese dishes are 830–840.
imageAlt: Bowl of penne chicken alfredo pasta topped with grilled chicken and parsley

faqs.question: How much is pasta at Domino’s?
faqs.answer: $8.49 for the Chicken Alfredo, the 5-Cheese Mac & Cheese or the Spicy Buffalo 5-Cheese Mac & Cheese at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026.

faqs.question: Is the pasta a full meal?
faqs.answer: One adult serving, but a modest one by restaurant standards. Most people eating it as their only item are still hungry afterwards, which is why it works better as part of a bundle than on its own.

faqs.question: Does it count toward mix-and-match deals?
faqs.answer: At most chains yes, and that is where its value lies. Paying the flat bundle rate for a pasta is considerably better than paying menu price for it.

faqs.question: Why does the sauce separate?
faqs.answer: Cream-based sauces split as they cool and sit. It is at its best soon after baking, which makes it a better carryout item than one to order on a long delivery.

title: Oven-Baked Sandwiches
description: Five oven-baked sandwiches — Italian, Philly cheese steak, chicken parm, chicken bacon ranch, buffalo chicken — all one price.
fullContent:
The sandwich section of a pizza menu uses the same ingredients as the pizza section in a different arrangement — same meats, same cheese, same oven. That is not a criticism; it is why the sandwiches are consistent and why they are cheap for the store to produce.

Where it fits on value

Every sandwich costs $8.99 in our check, whichever filling you choose. Like the pasta, it is a bundle item. At the flat rate inside a two-for offer it is good value; at full menu price it is competing with every sandwich shop in your neighbourhood and generally loses.

What you are actually getting

A baked roll with one of five fillings — Italian meats, Philly cheese steak, chicken parm, chicken bacon ranch or buffalo chicken — heated through in the pizza oven so the cheese melts and the bread crisps. The official cart lists calories per half sandwich, from 370 for the Philly to 470 for the chicken bacon ranch.

Ordering notes

Ask for the dressing on the side if it is being delivered. Dressed sandwiches go soft in the middle within twenty minutes of leaving the oven, and this is the most common complaint about the item.

Removing vegetables is free; adding extra meat is not. As with the pizzas, subtracting is the cheap way to customise.

The portion is one substantial adult serving. Unlike the pasta, most people find it genuinely filling on its own.
caloriesNote: Per half sandwich (Italian), as listed in the official cart; the range is 370–470.
imageAlt: Italian sub sandwich with salami, ham, lettuce, tomato and peppers

faqs.question: How much is a sandwich at Domino’s?
faqs.answer: $8.99 for any of the five oven-baked sandwiches at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026.

faqs.question: Why does it go soggy?
faqs.answer: The dressing soaks into a warm roll during transit. Asking for it on the side solves the problem entirely and takes five seconds to fix when it arrives.

faqs.question: Can I customise the fillings?
faqs.answer: Removing items is free at most stores; adding extra meat or cheese is charged. That is the same pricing logic as the pizzas.

faqs.question: Is one sandwich enough for a meal?
faqs.answer: For most people, yes. It is more filling than the pasta and is a reasonable standalone order in a way the pasta is not.

title: Lava Cake Flight
description: Three individual molten lava cakes — chocolate or s’mores, your mix. The most reliably good dessert on the menu.
fullContent:
Lava cakes arrive at the store part-baked and are finished in the oven when you order, which is why they come out with a liquid centre rather than a uniformly cooked one. That process is also why they are consistent between stores in a way that few dessert items are.

Where it fits on value

The Lava Cake Flight is three cakes for $9.99 in our check — about $3.33 a cake — and you choose the mix of chocolate and s’mores. As a shared dessert for three that is reasonable; for one person it is a lot of cake.

Ordering notes

Eat it soon. The molten centre sets as it cools and a lava cake that has spent forty minutes in a delivery bag is just a small chocolate cake. Of everything on the menu, this is the item most improved by carryout.

The flight is three cakes. For two people, the third cake is the one that gets left until it has set.

Nutrition note

About 360 calories per cake in the official cart. It is a genuinely rich item and is best understood as a shared dessert rather than an individual one, whatever the packaging suggests.
caloriesNote: Per cake, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Chocolate lava cake with a molten centre next to a scoop of vanilla ice cream

faqs.question: Why is the centre sometimes solid?
faqs.answer: Because it has cooled. The molten centre sets as the temperature drops, so a long delivery leaves you with a normal chocolate cake. Carryout, or eating it promptly, is the whole trick.

faqs.question: How many come in an order?
faqs.answer: Three in the Lava Cake Flight — $9.99 in our check — in any mix of chocolate and s’mores.

faqs.question: Can it be reheated?
faqs.answer: Twenty seconds in a microwave will re-melt the centre reasonably well. It is one of the few items on the menu where the microwave is the right tool.

title: Cinnamon Bread Bites
description: Sixteen pieces of pizza dough baked with cinnamon sugar, with an icing dip. The cheapest dessert per person.
fullContent:
Cinnamon Bread Bites are the dessert version of the garlic and parmesan Bread Bites: the same small pieces of dough, baked with cinnamon sugar instead, with an icing dip. Sixteen pieces for $5.99 in our check makes them the cheapest dessert on the menu per person.

Where it fits on value

Sixteen pieces covers four people at four each, about $1.50 a head. The Lava Cake Flight is $9.99 for three cakes — over $3 a head for three people. For a group where dessert is an afterthought, the bread bites are the better buy; for two people who want a proper dessert, the lava cakes win.

Ordering notes

The icing cup came with the order in our check; it is worth confirming it is in your basket before you pay. They harden as they cool like any bread side, so they are best eaten within half an hour.
caloriesNote: Per 4 pieces, as listed in the official cart; the icing cup adds 220.
imageAlt: Cinnamon sugar dough pieces with a small bowl of icing dip

faqs.question: How much are Cinnamon Bread Bites?
faqs.answer: $5.99 for 16 pieces with an icing dip at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026.

faqs.question: How many people does one order feed?
faqs.answer: About four as an after-pizza dessert, at four pieces each.

faqs.question: Are they lighter than the lava cakes?
faqs.answer: Per serving, yes: 230 calories for four pieces against 360 per lava cake in the official cart — though the icing cup adds another 220 if you use all of it.

title: 2-Liter Soda
description: Coke, Diet Coke, Cherry Coke, Sprite or Fanta Orange in a two-liter bottle. The group drink, and one of the easiest lines to cut.
fullContent:
A two-liter bottle cost $4.49 in our check — noticeably more than the same bottle in a supermarket. That is not a scandal — it is a convenience charge, and it is the single easiest line item to remove from a pizza order if you are trying to cut the total.

Where it fits on value

Poor, as a standalone purchase. Considerably better inside a bundle that includes a drink at no extra cost, which several family offers do. If the bundle includes it, take it; if it costs extra, consider whether you have a shop on your street.

Ordering notes

It arrives at whatever temperature the store's stock is kept at, which is often room temperature rather than chilled. If cold drinks matter, ask when ordering — some stores keep chilled stock and some genuinely do not.

One two-litre bottle serves roughly six to eight glasses. For a group of four it is the right amount; for two people it is more than you will finish.

A cheaper approach

Ordering food for delivery and drinks from a shop is the standard way regular orderers cut ten to fifteen percent off a family order without giving anything up. It is the least painful saving available on a pizza order.
caloriesNote: Per 12 fl oz of Coke, as listed in the official cart; Diet Coke is 0.
imageAlt: Glasses of cola, lemon-lime and orange soda poured over ice

faqs.question: How much is a 2-liter at Domino’s?
faqs.answer: $4.49 for any of the five flavours we saw — Coke, Diet Coke, Cherry Coke, Sprite and Fanta Orange — at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026.

faqs.question: Is the soda chilled?
faqs.answer: Not always. Many stores keep bottled stock at room temperature. If you need it cold, ask when you order rather than assuming.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to buy drinks separately?
faqs.answer: Usually by roughly half. Buying drinks from a shop and food from the pizza store is the simplest way to cut ten to fifteen percent off a family order.

faqs.question: How many people does one bottle serve?
faqs.answer: Six to eight glasses, so about right for four people. For two, it is more than you will get through.

title: Bottled Water & Sweet Tea
description: Single bottles for one person: Dasani water and Gold Peak sweet tea. Convenient, and priced like it.
fullContent:
The single-bottle drinks are for one-person orders and for people who do not want two liters of soda in the fridge afterwards. In our check a 20-ounce Dasani and a Gold Peak Sweet Tea both cost $3.49.

Where it fits on value

A 20-ounce bottle at $3.49 costs almost as much as a two-liter at $4.49 while holding less than a third of the liquid. For one person that is a fair trade for convenience; for two or more, the two-liter is far better value.

Ordering notes

What a store keeps in its cooler varies more than any other part of the menu, so check what your store actually lists. Water is the one item we would suggest simply not ordering: it is the line on the board with the biggest gap between price and what it costs you at home.
caloriesNote: Dasani water; Gold Peak Sweet Tea is 190 per bottle, as listed in the official cart.
imageAlt: Bottles of water and assorted fruit juices on a table

faqs.question: How much is a bottle of water at Domino’s?
faqs.answer: $3.49 for a 20-ounce Dasani at the Columbus, Ohio store we checked on 25 October 2026 — the same as a Gold Peak Sweet Tea.

faqs.question: Is a bottle better value than a two-liter?
faqs.answer: No: $3.49 for 20 ounces against $4.49 for 2 liters (about 68 ounces). The bottle only makes sense for one person.

faqs.question: How many calories are in the sweet tea?
faqs.answer: 190 per bottle, as listed in the official cart. The water has none.
